<!-- Generated by tools/refgen from spin-terraform-aws:images.json. Edit the source, not this file. -->

Every machine of an installation boots Spin OS, built for one release of spin. The module reads the image of each machine from its `images.json`, by `spin_version` and region, so an installation of `v20261026.02` can be made in a region listed here and nowhere else. To boot images of your own, name them with `image_ids` and their measurements with `image_measurements` ([the module's variables](/reference/terraform/root/#image_ids)).

| Region | Control plane | Proxy | Runner |
|---|---|---|---|
| `us-east-1` | `ami-0774cba716732d76f` | `ami-0d23fd135c2b1569a` | `ami-04dfd5df7d3bbaf5a` |
| `us-west-2` | `ami-0c0458b4218567425` | `ami-08808879d20e484cc` | `ami-0a2410b4fdd3f37e2` |
